adaptive_rule: At a completed 16:00 New York session close, if portfolio equity is at least 5% below its observed peak, reduce requested gross target from 2 to 0.5 at the next market open. One-way latch; no retuning or recovery switch.
risk_peak: Mark-to-market equity observed at each received hourly bar; decision only at session close. Excludes unobserved intrabar path.
buying_power_model: Upstream SecurityMarginModel(2m), constant illustrative 50% initial/maintenance requirement; native DefaultMarginCallModel remains enabled. This is not Alpaca compliance.
price_data: Bundled LEAN SPY hourly trade bars, raw normalization; no tick/quote or availability attestation.
dividends: Record native raw-data cash distributions and include them in reconciliation; reject unexpected splits.
financing: No financing/borrow interest configured; no funding-inclusive investment claim.
acceptance: Native completion and no data request failures
Every discretionary fill strictly after its recorded decision
Flat final positions and fill/fee/distribution cash reconciliation
Actual insufficient-buying-power rejection and zero fills in over_limit
Exactly one adaptive reduction decision; observe margin calls rather than suppressing them
Preserve all six outcomes, input hashes and exact commands; do not rank or promote a winner
scope: Known-stress development interval chosen before runs, not an untouched holdout. Mechanics only; no catalyst, +200% mover, full PIT universe, actual margin account, capacity or strategy validation.
